_README: Weights + specs transcribed from Decathlon in-store comparison spec boards (photographed by user, batch 1 = 13 photos, 2026-07-07). Decathlon supplies NO weights via Awin and 403s all scraping, so these store boards are the weight source. KEY = Decathlon 8-digit article/model code (joins to the Awin feed's model/product code). `skus` lists every code shown for that model (color/size variants share a model but may differ by code). weightGrams = the board's stated weight; for size-variant products (pads L/XL, bags 'in size L') see weightBySize + weightRefNote. Third-party brands sold at Decathlon (Petzl/Black Diamond/Komperdell/Deuter/Sea to Summit) are marked thirdParty:true — capture the weight but the Decathlon/Awin offer is a RESOLD offer (brand != retailer), same pattern as the FF-resold Arc/Pat items. NO-WEIGHT items (lanterns, flashlights, Arpenaz daypacks, car-camping air beds) are listed under _noWeightAvailable for scope reference only.
_batch3Note: Batch 3 = NL store trip 2026-07-11 (22 photos, arriving in sub-batches). Photos 1-2 (Simond bags + pads boards) were exact repeats of batch 1 — already captured above. NEW: women's trekking boots (weights, size 38/shoe), women's light-hiking (weights), men's+women's NH walking shoes (weights, size 42/38 per shoe), men's+women's MH mountain-hiking boards (NO weight row on those boards), Quechua/Simond sock board (no weights). FOOTWEAR CONVENTION: boards give PER-SHOE weight; catalog stores PAIR = 2x (user decision 2026-07-10).
_photoBatchesExpected: user will make one more store trip to fill gaps (see _gapsToPhotograph)

_joinMechanics.feed: AWIN advertiser feed fid/65881 (.env AWIN_DECATHLON_FEED_URL), UK/English, ~57.6k rows. Download: curl -sL $URL | gunzip. NOT the 5,368-row category feed (that one is mostly apparel; tents/bags/pads/headlamps absent).
_joinMechanics.joinKey: The 8-digit store article code = the PREFIX of `merchant_product_id` (e.g. '8858233-5133809' -> '8858233'). NOT `model_number` (that is a different internal id like '310893'). Join store-specs skus[] to feed rows via merchant_product_id.split('-')[0].
_joinMechanics.multiRow: One article code appears in MULTIPLE feed rows — one per merchant_category it's merchandised in. Collect all rows for a code; pick the most descriptive merchant_category (drop promo buckets: Summer Sale, Womens Sale, Hiking Sale, New Collection, Sportswear Accessories, Festival Bags). parent_product_id is EMPTY (no variant grouping from feed).
_joinMechanics.offer: aw_deep_link is the awin1.com pclick affiliate URL -> use as MerchantOffer.deepLink (network 'awin', merchantId 26895, merchantName 'Decathlon'). Image from merchant_image_url / aw_image_url (+ alternate_image*). Price from search_price. Filter in_stock=1.
_joinMechanics.brandAuthority: Use the feed's brand_name, NOT the brand guessed in this file. The MT500/MT900 trekking TENTS and PACKS come through as brand=SIMOND in the feed (Decathlon shifted the MT trekking line to Simond). Reconcile at build time.
_joinMechanics.attributeSource: For PHOTOGRAPHED items use the specs in THIS file (capacity/comfortTempC/rValue/capacityLiters/fill etc.) — richer + exact. merchant_category parsing is only a fallback for non-photographed breadth items (encodes capacity '3 Man Tents', volume '20L to 30L Backpacks', etc.).

_itemTypeMap._note: Authoritative SCHEMAS itemType per category (attributeSchemas.js). The per-entry `itemType` in batch-1 arrays is ADVISORY and in some cases NOT a valid SCHEMAS key — build with THIS map instead.
_itemTypeMap.headlamps: Torch Light (no dedicated Headlamp type; Torch Light covers head/hand torches)
_itemTypeMap.tents: Backpacking Tent; the Tarp MT900 entries -> Tarp Shelter
_itemTypeMap.sleepingPads: padType 'Closed-Cell Foam' -> Foam Sleeping Pad; else (Inflatable / Self-Inflating) -> Inflatable Sleeping Pad
_itemTypeMap.sleepingBags: Sleeping Bag; the Quilt Sprint entry -> Sleeping Bag (no Quilt type)
_itemTypeMap.backpacksTrekking/backpacksHiking/backpa: Backpack (used by existing scripts; no attribute schema, carry attrs leniently). Small daypacks -> Daypack.
_itemTypeMap.trekkingBoots/walkingShoes: Mid-cut / leather / stiff trekking -> Hiking Boots. LOW-cut hiking shoes (NH50/NH100/NH500 Low, MT100, Arpenaz Revival) have NO matching schema — SCHEMAS only has 'Hiking Boots' + 'Trail Running Shoes'. DECISION NEEDED: add a 'Hiking Shoes' itemType (recommended) or lump lows into Hiking Boots.
